title: No Cost to Correct
read_query: SELECT text FROM poem_surface ORDER BY slot
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE inspection_items(item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, display_order INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, item TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, move_out TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(move_out IN ('GOOD','FAIR','POOR')), cost_to_correct_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cost_to_correct_cents >= 0), normal_wear INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(normal_wear IN (0,1))) STRICT

CREATE TABLE moveout_response(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), agree INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(agree IN (0,1)), disagree INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(disagree IN (0,1)), CHECK(agree + disagree <= 1)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE disagreements(item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES inspection_items(item_id), detail_order INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(detail_order > 0), detail TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(item_id, detail_order)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE occupancy(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), persons_present INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(persons_present IN (0,1)), usual_residence_elsewhere INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(usual_residence_elsewhere IN (0,1)), vacancy_status TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN persons_present = 1 AND usual_residence_elsewhere = 1 THEN 'VACANT' WHEN persons_present = 1 THEN 'OCCUPIED' ELSE 'VACANT' END) VIRTUAL) STRICT

The WAL changes the response, inserts six disagreement details and one occupancy row, and the occupancy table computes VACANT through a VIRTUAL generated column while the main database bytes remain unchanged before checkpoint.
